# League Night Pro

> League Night Pro is web-based golf league management software for organizers and golf clubs. It combines season setup, player and team management, event scheduling, flight generation, score entry, standings, league intelligence, and annual season renewal in one application.

Official website: https://leaguenightpro.com/
Support: support@leaguenightpro.com

## Product

- [League Night Pro](https://leaguenightpro.com/): Product overview, capabilities, workflow, pricing, and account registration.
- [Detailed product information](https://leaguenightpro.com/llms-full.txt): Machine-readable product facts, features, audiences, and pricing details.
- [Golf league scoring software](https://leaguenightpro.com/golf-league-scoring-software): Supported formats, score entry, results, points, skins, and score history.
- [Golf league scheduling software](https://leaguenightpro.com/golf-league-scheduling-software): Season planning, events, flights, matchups, and scorecards.
- [Golf league handicap tracking](https://leaguenightpro.com/golf-league-handicap-tracking): Stored handicaps, allowances, historical movement, and net scoring.
- [Software for golf league commissioners](https://leaguenightpro.com/golf-league-software-for-commissioners): Weekly operations, administration, member engagement, and renewal.
- [Golf league standings and statistics](https://leaguenightpro.com/golf-league-standings-and-statistics): Standings, player statistics, team performance, records, skins, and event recaps.

## Key facts

- Designed for recurring golf leagues, league seasons, and tournaments.
- Supports individual and team formats, stroke play and match play, 9-hole and 18-hole scoring, flights, printable scorecards, skins, standings, and player statistics.
- Provides league, player, team, event, matchup, and commissioner insights from recorded league results.
- League administrators can create a new season from a previous season while preserving legacy rounds and reusing player data.
- Pricing is $10 USD per regular golfer for each league season, with an eight-golfer minimum. Substitutes do not increase the price.
- League-season purchases are one-time payments and do not automatically renew.
